title: 谁在冬天睡大觉
subtitle: 把身体调慢，等春天
character: wearing a thick blue jumper, dark trousers and boots, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, winter gouache on textured paper, soft rounded shapes with fine outlines, cool blue-grey, warm brown and cream, quiet and cosy

pages.zh:
冬天来了，
院子里安安静静的。
夏天那些虫子和小鸟，
忽然都不见了。
它们去哪儿了呢？
pages.scene: The little boy stands in a bare winter yard in a thick jumper, looking around at the empty branches.

pages.zh:
有的飞走了，
有的躲起来睡觉。
躲起来睡一冬天，
这件事叫「冬眠」。
pages.scene: One tree hollow on a cream background with a small curled-up animal shape inside it, sleeping. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
冬眠可不是普通的睡觉。
身体会把自己调慢：
体温降下来，
心跳慢下来，
呼吸也变得很轻。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two rows on a cream background: the top row a wavy line with many close peaks, the bottom row the same line stretched out with far fewer peaks. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
为什么要这样呢？
因为冬天找不到吃的。
身体调慢了，
用的力气就少，
靠秋天存的那点脂肪就够撑。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two bars side by side on a cream background: a tall one and a much shorter one, each with a small animal symbol above it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
土拨鼠是真正的冬眠。
它在洞里蜷成一团，
几个月几乎不动，
偶尔才醒一小会儿。
pages.scene: One burrow cross-section on a cream background with a round curled animal asleep at the bottom. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
熊不太一样。
它的体温降得不多，
睡得也浅，
有时候还会出来走走。
所以不算真正的冬眠。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two thermometers side by side on a cream background: the left one with the liquid very low, the right one only slightly lower than normal. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
青蛙和乌龟
钻进池塘底的泥里。
那里的水不会结冰，
它们把自己埋起来，
慢慢等。
pages.scene: One pond cross-section on a cream background with ice on top, a frog and a turtle both buried in the mud at the bottom.

pages.zh:
松鼠不冬眠。
它秋天到处藏坚果，
冬天再一个一个找出来。
有些忘了挖，
后来就长成了树。
pages.scene: One squirrel on a cream background burying a nut at the foot of a tree, with a small sprout nearby. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
冬眠的动物最怕被吵醒。
醒一次要花掉
好多存下来的力气。
醒太多次，
可能就撑不到春天。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one bar on a cream background divided into ten equal segments, with three of them crossed out. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
什么时候醒呢？
天气暖起来，
土变松，
身体就知道春天到了。
它们自己会醒。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one thermometer on a cream background with the liquid rising, and one arrow beside it pointing up. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
所以冬天看见树洞、
看见地上的小洞，
别去掏、别去敲。
里面也许
正有谁在睡觉。
pages.scene: One tree hollow and one small burrow opening on a cream background, both quiet and undisturbed. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我蹲下来，
看见墙根有个小洞。
我没有去掏它。
我小声说了句：
春天见。
pages.scene: The little boy crouches beside a small hole at the foot of a wall, not touching it, speaking softly.
